capabilities: : Perform semantic search on indexed content
: Render full documents in a read-only preview
: Configure backend MCP server URL and token
: Surface backend warnings as in-app notices
disambiguation: This plugin is a client only; it does not perform indexing or search itself.
problem: Users need a way to search and view documents indexed in a separate DocSanctum knowledge base directly within the Obsidian interface.
summary: Client-side plugin that connects to a self-hosted DocSanctum backend via MCP to search and read indexed documents within Obsidian.
